intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that arthrogryposis multiplex congenita-9 with immunodeficiency (AMC9) is caused by homozygous mutation in the SENP7 gene (612846) on chromosome 3q12.3.

checks.claim: Arthrogryposis multiplex congenita-9 with immunodeficiency (AMC9) is caused by homozygous mutation in the SENP7 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: Exome sequencing identified a homozygous stop gain variant in SENP7 c.1474C>T; p.(Gln492*) as the probable aetiology.
checks.explanation: The paper names the homozygous SENP7 variant as the probable cause of the disorder. The name AMC9 is OMIM's label for it.

checks.claim: The SENP7 gene is located on chromosome 3q12.3.
checks.evidence_quote: Exome sequencing identified a homozygous stop gain variant in SENP7
checks.explanation: The chromosomal location 3q12.3 is standard nomenclature added to the SENP7 gene that the paper names. The abstract does not state the location itself.

paragraphs.text: Arthrogryposis multiplex congenita-9 with immunodeficiency (AMC9) is an autosomal recessive, usually lethal disorder. Its main features are congenital arthrogryposis, neurodevelopmental abnormalities, dysmorphism, and immunodeficiency with neutropenia, hypogammaglobulinemia, and recurrent infections. Affected infants have early respiratory failure and die in infancy (Samra et al., 2023; Kobayashi et al., 2024). Prenatal findings can also include central nervous system malformations, congenital heart disease, and renal anomalies (Saad et al., 2025).

checks.evidence_quote: identified rare, biallelic, specifically homozygous, loss of function variants in SENP7
checks.explanation: Biallelic homozygous variants imply autosomal recessive inheritance.

checks.evidence_quote: ultimately death in infancy for all 4 patients
checks.explanation: All reported patients died, which is consistent with a usually lethal disorder.

checks.evidence_quote: a spectrum of findings including congenital arthrogryposis
checks.explanation: Stated directly.

checks.explanation: Not reaching developmental milestones is a neurodevelopmental abnormality.

paragraphs.text: Saad et al. (2025) performed singleton exome sequencing on fetal DNA from a consanguineous Egyptian family with recurrent lethal multiple congenital anomalies, including arthrogryposis multiplex congenita. They identified a homozygous stop-gain mutation in the SENP7 gene (c.745C-T; R249X). The resulting premature termination codon was predicted to cause nonsense-mediated decay of the mutant mRNA. The authors proposed that the mutation impairs the isopeptidase activity of SENP7 in deconjugating polySUMO chains.

checks.explanation: The abstract states that singleton exome sequencing was done on fetal DNA from this family.

checks.claim: Saad et al. (2025) identified a homozygous c.745C-T transition in the SENP7 gene, resulting in an arg249-to-ter (R249X) substitution, in the Egyptian family.
checks.evidence_quote: a novel homozygous stop-gain variant in SENP7 c.745C>T; p.(Arg249*) in a consanguineous Egyptian family
checks.explanation: c.745C>T p.(Arg249*) is the same variant as c.745C-T R249X; a C>T change is a transition.

checks.claim: The premature termination codon from SENP7 R249X was predicted to cause nonsense-mediated decay of the mutant mRNA.
checks.evidence_quote: which results in a premature termination codon, and the mutant mRNA is predicted to be degraded by nonsense-mediated decay (NMD).
checks.explanation: The paper states that nonsense-mediated decay is predicted.

paragraphs.text: Pal et al. (2025) reported a novel missense variant in the SENP7 gene in a patient with fatal arthrogryposis multiplex congenita and immunodeficiency (AMC9).

checks.claim: Pal et al. (2025) reported a novel missense variant in the SENP7 gene in a patient with fatal arthrogryposis multiplex congenita and immunodeficiency (AMC9).
checks.evidence_quote: SENP7-Related Fatal Arthrogryposis Multiplex Congenita and Immunodeficiency: A Novel Missense Variation and Syndromic Delineation.
checks.explanation: The title supports a novel SENP7 missense variant in this phenotype. The AMC9 designation is standard OMIM nomenclature.
